events.title: Abdelmadjid Tebboune Wildfire
events.summary: Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune has proposed reinstating the death penalty for individuals found guilty of deliberately setting forest fires. Currently, 46 fires are still active across several eastern provinces, with many victims hospitalized, some in critical condition.

events.latest_title: Deadly Wildfires in Algeria's Jijel Province Prompt National Mourning

events.latest_title: Hungary Faces Severe Water Crisis as Drought Drains Lakes and Rivers
